body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> aigo presented its 4.8-inch ultra-low power consumption MID 'P8880' at the CES 2009.

Adopting a 4.8-inch touch-activated display, the MID-P8880 is powered by Intel Menlow CPU(800MHz) and Linux OS for open application architecture. Other features included wireless WAN, WiFi, Bluetooth 2.0 and GPS.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
